logit_vs_probability_are_different_funct.conclusion: the two registered rules disagree whenever components disagree

multiselect_recomputation.conclusion: §9 requires each component to be renormalised over the shrinking legal set and re-averaged; renormalising a single previously averaged distribution is a different distribution

ensemble_is_not_a_weight_soup.conclusion: a ReLU network at averaged parameters is not the average of the networks, so §2 forbids treating the families as equivalent
